# Radoslav Radev Says The Five Steps To The 90 Degree Handstand Push-Up Need No Equipment Except Parallettes

Radoslav Radev says you will not need any equipment except the parallettes for the five steps. [src: vid-zHXpQgVJEHo @ 00:17]

## Details

- You will not need any equipment except the parallettes, no resistance bands or anything. [src: vid-zHXpQgVJEHo @ 00:17]
- He says he shows the five steps without any extra equipment. [src: vid-zHXpQgVJEHo @ 00:22]
